data.narrative:
Darkhive is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $22M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 peer companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing—all operating in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $22M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical for Series A advancement, implying a valuation of $44M. Peer-Median analysis examines 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables: Stark Defence ($4.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M). The median across this peer set is $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $4.0B.

Synthesizing these two methods produces a triangulated range of $37M (low) to $460M (high), with a median of $222M. The wide dispersion between the stage-progression and peer-median approaches reflects material uncertainty around which peers are most comparable to Darkhive's specific technology, market position, and capital efficiency. The peer set exhibits outsized outliers (Stark Defence at $4.0B), suggesting that stage and sector alone may not fully explain valuation variance. Key uncertainties include customer traction, defensibility of the technology, and whether Darkhive's profile aligns more closely with the $125M or $400M tier of peers.
